description: This file contains unit tests for the BonjourEscapes decoding functionality in Swift. It tests various escape sequence decoding scenarios including handling spaces, multiple escapes, invalid sequences, and decimal Unicode scalar values.

methods.name: decodePassThrough
methods.description: Tests that the decode function returns the input string unchanged when there are no escape sequences.

methods.name: decodeSpaces
methods.description: Tests decoding of a space escape sequence.

methods.name: decodeMultipleEscapes
methods.description: Tests decoding of multiple escape sequences within the string.

methods.name: decodeIgnoresInvalidEscapeSequences
methods.description: Ensures that invalid escape sequences are left unchanged.

methods.name: decodeUsesDecimalUnicodeScalarValue
methods.description: Tests decoding of a decimal Unicode scalar escape sequence.
